The '''''Zaff Jendinpurg''''' was an [[EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate/Legends|EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate]] that belonged to the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], it was assigned to be the escort [[Frigate/Legends|frigate]] of the [[Star Galleon-class frigate|''Star Galleon''-class frigate]] [[Emperor's Will (Star Galleon-class)|''Emperor's Will'']] as the treasure [[Starship/Legends|ship]] traveled to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Esseles/Legends|Esseles]]. However, on the way there, both the ''Zaff Jendinpurg'' and its charge were suddenly brought out of [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] by [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroids]] that had been dragged in front of their course by the ''[[Far Orbit]]'', a Nebulon-B [[Privateer/Legends|privateer]] vessel serving the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]]. The ''Far Orbit'' quickly dispatched the ''Zaff Jendinpurg'' before [[Capture of the Emperor's Will|seizing]] the ''Emperor's Will''{{'s}} valuable cargo.

==Description==
The ''Zaff Jendinpurg'' was an [[EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate/Legends|EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate]]<ref name="Prize" /> produced by [[Kuat Drive Yards/Legends|Kuat Drive Yards]].<ref name="NEGVV-KDY" /> Measuring 300 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] in length,<ref name="NEGVV-size" /> the escort [[Frigate/Legends|frigate]] was equipped with a [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]], a [[Deflector shield generator/Legends|deflector shield generator]], and had an armament consisting of twelve [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolaser]] [[Cannon/Legends|cannons]], a dozen [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannons]], and a pair of [[Tractor beam/Legends|tractor beam]] generators. The ''Zaff Jendinpurg'' also had a complement of twenty-four [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]]. Additionally, it had braking [[Engine/Legends|thrusters]] and multiple engines.<ref name="Prize" />

==History==
As of [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]],<ref name="Date">{{FarOrbitDate}}</ref> when the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] was fighting the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] in the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the ''Zaff Jendinpurg'' was a vessel owned by the Empire. That [[Standard year/Legends|year]], it was assigned to guard the treasure-bearing [[Star Galleon-class frigate|''Star Galleon''-class frigate]] [[Emperor's Will (Star Galleon-class)|''Emperor's Will'']] as it traveled from the [[Arkanis sector/Legends|Arkanis sector]] to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Esseles/Legends|Esseles]].<ref name="Raid">{{WEGCite|story=Raid on Brentaal|book=The Far Orbit Project}}</ref>

{{RPGseed}}
However, on the way to Esseles, both the ''Zaff Jendinpurg'' and its charge were abruptly pulled from [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] to [[Realspace/Legends|realspace]] because a few [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroids]] had blocked their course. The Alliance Nebulon-B [[Privateer/Legends|privateer]] [[Frigate/Legends|frigate]] ''[[Far Orbit]]'' had dragged the asteroids there with the intention of capturing the ''Emperor's Will''{{'s}} cargo after an [[Unidentified Rebel waiter|informant]] [[Mission to Brentaal IV|provided]] the privateers with the Star Galleon's route. The sudden departure from hyperspace damaged the ''Zaff Jendinpurg'' and caused it to veer wildly. The ''Far Orbit'' took both Imperial [[Starship/Legends|ships]] by surprise, allowing the privateers to gain an advantage as they moved to [[Capture of the Emperor's Will|engage]] their targets. However, despite launching its complement of fighters and firing upon the ''Far Orbit'' with its cannons, the ''Zaff Jendinpurg'' succumbed to the privateering ship's fire, and it was destroyed. The ''Far Orbit'' proceeded to disable the ''Emperor's Will'' and steal its cargo.<ref name="Prize" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
The ''Zaff Jendinpurg'' was first mentioned in ''[[Raid on Brentaal]]'', an [[Roleplaying game|adventure]] scenario in [[1998]]'s ''[[The Far Orbit Project]]'', by [[Timothy S. O'Brien]].<ref name="Raid" /> The ship first appeared in ''[[The Grand Prize]]'', another scenario published in ''The Far Orbit Project''. The book was a supplement to [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]'' and had the same theme of the previous publication, ''[[Pirates & Privateers]]'', as it followed the privateering vessel ''Far Orbit''. In ''The Grand Prize'', gamemasters can choose whether the ''Zaff Jendinpurg'' is heavily or lightly damaged by the reversion to realspace caused by the asteroids.<ref name="Prize" />
